part1_forecasts.statement: There is a 78% chance that the U.S. Commerce Department will issue at least one additional Is-Informed Letter restricting frontier model transfers to foreign persons before August 2028.

resolution_criteria.metric: count of Is-Informed Letters issued restricting frontier model transfers
resolution_criteria.counting_convention: unit: Is-Informed Letters; status: officially published by the Commerce Department; window: between June 2026 and June 2028; excludes: routine administrative guidance or advisory opinions.

part1_forecasts.statement: There is a 68% chance that the U.S. Bureau of Industry and Security will formally revoke the authorized status of at least five additional IC designers under interim final rules before August 2028.

resolution_criteria.metric: count of IC designers losing authorized status
resolution_criteria.counting_convention: unit: IC designers; status: formally revoked status under BIS interim final rules; window: between April 2026 and June 2028; excludes: voluntary withdrawals.
